question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To make matters worse
solution:
The correct answer is **"****Make the situation worse." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **To make matters worse *(idiom) - ***make the situation worse

 
 
• ***Eg. **** He inquired about this with my project leader, which has made the situation worse.*​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let's look at some other idioms:

 
• **​Make a splash *(idiom) -* **To be very successful and garner a lot of public attention
 
• **To make a blanket statement (*idiom)*** - To make a general statement about a large group of different people or things that is typically lacking in nuance and accuracy.
